Chapter 5

Backing Up and Restoring etcdetcd 备份与恢复

Kubernetes stores both the declared and observed states of the cluster in the distributed etcd key-value store. It’s important to have a backup plan in place that can help you with restoring the data in case of data corruption. Backing up the data should happen periodically in short time frames to avoid losing as much historical data as possible.

Kubernetes 把集群的声明状态和观测状态都存储在分布式 etcd 键值存储中。务必制定一份备份计划，以便在数据损坏时帮助你恢复数据。备份应按较短的时间周期定期进行，以尽可能少地丢失历史数据。

Coverage of Curriculum Objective考试大纲考点覆盖

This chapter addresses the following curriculum objective: Manage the lifecycle of Kubernetes clusters.

本章对应以下考试大纲考点：管理 Kubernetes 集群的生命周期。

Using the etcd Administration Utilities使用 etcd 管理工具

The backup process stores the etcd data in a snapshot file. This snapshot file can be used to restore the etcd data at any given time. You can encrypt the snapshot file to protect sensitive information. The tool etcdctl is used to create a backup snapshot file. Restoring the etcd data from the snapshot file requires the use of the tool etcdutl.

备份过程会把 etcd 数据存入一个快照文件。这个快照文件可在任何时候用来恢复 etcd 数据。你可以对快照文件加密以保护敏感信息。创建备份快照文件使用 etcdctl 工具；而从快照文件恢复 etcd 数据则需要使用 etcdutl 工具。

As an administrator, you will need to understand how to use the tools for both operations. You may need to install etcdctl and etcdutl if they are not available on the control plane node yet. You can find installation instructions in the etcd GitHub repository. Figure 5-1 visualizes the etcd backup and restoration process.

作为管理员，你需要理解如何使用这两个工具完成这两类操作。如果控制平面节点上还没有 etcdctl 和 etcdutl，你可能需要先安装它们。安装说明见 etcd 的 GitHub 仓库。图 5-1 可视化地展示了 etcd 的备份与恢复过程。

— PDF p.73 —

Depending on your cluster topology, your cluster may consist of one or many etcd instances. Refer to “Managing a Highly Available Cluster” on page 40 for more information on how to set it up. The following sections explain a single-node etcd cluster setup. You can find additional instructions on the backup and restoration process for multinode etcd clusters in the official Kubernetes documentation.

根据你的集群拓扑，集群可能包含一个或多个 etcd 实例。如何搭建的更多信息见第 40 页“Managing a Highly Available Cluster”。下面的小节讲解单节点 etcd 集群的搭建。多节点 etcd 集群的备份与恢复流程，可在官方 Kubernetes 文档中找到额外说明。

Backing Up etcd备份 etcd

Open an interactive shell to the machine hosting etcd using the ssh command. The following command targets the control plane node named kube-control-plane running Ubuntu 24.04 LTS:

使用 ssh 命令打开到托管 etcd 机器的交互式 shell。下面的命令连接名为 kube-control-plane、运行 Ubuntu 24.04 LTS 的控制平面节点：

$ ssh kube-control-plane
Welcome to Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (GNU/Linux 6.8.0-51-generic x86_64)
...

Check the installed version of etcdctl to verify that the tool has been installed. On this node, the version is 3.5.15:

检查已安装的 etcdctl 版本，确认工具已装好。在这个节点上，版本是 3.5.15：

— PDF p.74 —
$ etcdctl version
etcdctl version: 3.5.15
API version: 3.5

Etcd is deployed as a Pod in the kube-system namespace. Inspect the version by describing the Pod. In the following output, you will find that the version is 3.5.15-0:

etcd 是以 Pod 形式部署在 kube-system namespace 中的。通过 describe 该 Pod 来查看版本。在下面的输出中，你会发现版本是 3.5.15-0：

$ kubectl get pods -n kube-system
NAME                                       READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
...
etcd-kube-control-plane                    1/1     Running   0          33m
...
$ kubectl describe pod etcd-kube-control-plane -n kube-system
...
Containers:
  etcd:
    Container ID:  containerd://47a6cf3ed27d455be6c9b782d2e35ee77b429ee5c0b
                   3c6c3d6282628f6492b15
    Image:         registry.k8s.io/etcd:3.5.15-0
    Image ID:      registry.k8s.io/etcd@sha256:a6dc63e6e8cfa0307d7851762fa6
                   b629afb18f28d8aa3fab5a6e91b4af60026a
...

The same describe command reveals the configuration of the etcd service. Look for the value of the option --listen-client-urls for the endpoint URL. In the following output, the host is localhost, and the port is 2379. The server certificate is located at /etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.crt defined by the option --cert-file. The CA certificate can be found at /etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/ca.crt specified by the option --trusted-ca-file:

同一个 describe 命令还会揭示 etcd 服务的配置。找一下选项 --listen-client-urls 的值，即端点 URL。在下面的输出中，主机是 localhost，端口是 2379。服务器证书位于 /etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.crt，由选项 --cert-file 定义；CA 证书位于 /etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/ca.crt，由选项 --trusted-ca-file 指定：

$ kubectl describe pod etcd-kube-control-plane -n kube-system
...
Containers:
  etcd:
    ...
    Command:
      etcd
      ...
      --cert-file=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.crt
      --key-file=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.key
      --listen-client-urls=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.key
      --trusted-ca-file=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/ca.crt
...

Use the etcdctl command to create the backup with version 3 of the tool. For a good starting point, copy the command from the official Kubernetes documentation. Provide the mandatory command-line options --cacert, --cert, and --key. The option --endpoints is not needed as we are running the command on the same server as etcd. After running the command, the file /opt/etcd-backup.db has been created:

使用 etcdctl 命令、并以工具的第 3 版 API 来创建备份。作为良好的起点，可以从官方 Kubernetes 文档复制该命令。提供必填的命令行选项 --cacert、--cert 和 --key。因为我们就在运行 etcd 的同一台服务器上执行命令，所以不需要 --endpoints 选项。运行命令后，文件 /opt/etcd-backup.db 即被创建：

— PDF p.75 —
$ sudo ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl --cacert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/ca.crt \
  --cert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.crt \
  --key=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.key \
  snapshot save /opt/etcd-backup.db
...
Snapshot saved at /opt/etcd-backup.db

Exit the node using the exit command:

使用 exit 命令退出该节点：

$ exit
logout
...

Restoring etcd恢复 etcd

You created a backup of etcd and stored it in a safe space. There’s nothing else to do at this time. Effectively, it’s your insurance policy that becomes relevant when disaster strikes. In the case of a disaster scenario—say, the data in etcd gets corrupted or the machine managing etcd experiences a physical storage failure—that’s the time when you want to pull out the etcd backup for restoration.

你已经创建了 etcd 备份并存放在安全之处。此时无需再做别的。实际上，它就是你的保险单，在灾难降临时才派上用场。当灾难发生时——比如 etcd 中的数据损坏，或管理 etcd 的机器发生物理存储故障——那就是你取出 etcd 备份进行恢复的时候。

To restore etcd from the backup, use the etcdutl snapshot restore command. At a minimum, provide the --data-dir command-line option.

要从备份恢复 etcd，使用 etcdutl snapshot restore 命令。至少要提供 --data-dir 命令行选项。

Deprecated etcdctl command已弃用的 etcdctl 命令

The etcdctl snapshot restore command has been deprecated and will be removed with the release of etcd 3.6. Use the etcdutl snapshot restore executable instead.

etcdctl snapshot restore 命令已被弃用，将在 etcd 3.6 发布时移除。请改用 etcdutl snapshot restore 可执行文件。

Open an interactive shell to the machine hosting etcd using the ssh command:

使用 ssh 命令打开到托管 etcd 机器的交互式 shell：

$ ssh kube-control-plane
Welcome to Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (GNU/Linux 6.8.0-51-generic x86_64)
...

After running the following command, you should be able to find the restored backup in the directory /var/lib/from-backup:

运行下面的命令后，你应该能在目录 /var/lib/from-backup 中找到恢复出来的备份：

$ sudo ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdutl --data-dir=/var/lib/from-backup snapshot restore \
  /opt/etcd-backup.db
...
$ sudo ls /var/lib/from-backup
member

Edit the YAML manifest of the etcd Pod, which can be found at /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml. Change the value of the attribute spec.volumes.hostPath with the name etcd-data from the original value /var/lib/etcd to /var/lib/from-backup:

编辑 etcd Pod 的 YAML manifest，该文件位于 /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml。把名为 etcd-data 的 spec.volumes.hostPath 属性的值，从原来的 /var/lib/etcd 改为 /var/lib/from-backup：

— PDF p.76 —
$ cd /etc/kubernetes/manifests/
$ sudo vim etcd.yaml
...
spec:
  volumes:
  ...
  - hostPath:
      path: /var/lib/from-backup
      type: DirectoryOrCreate
    name: etcd-data
...

The etcd-kube-control-plane Pod will be re-created, and it points to the restored backup directory:

etcd-kube-control-plane Pod 会被重新创建，并指向恢复出来的备份目录：

$ kubectl get pod etcd-kube-control-plane -n kube-system
NAME                      READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
etcd-kube-control-plane   1/1     Running   0          5m1s

In case the Pod doesn’t transition into the Running status, try to delete it manually with the command kubectl delete pod etcd-kube-control-plane -n kube-system.

如果该 Pod 没有进入 Running 状态，尝试用命令 kubectl delete pod etcd-kube-control-plane -n kube-system 手动删除它。

Exit the node using the exit command:

使用 exit 命令退出该节点：

$ exit
logout
...

Summary本章小结

Backing up the etcd database should be performed as a periodic process to prevent the loss of crucial data in the event of node or storage corruption. You can use the tool etcdctl to back up and the tool etcdutl to restore etcd from the control plane node or via an API endpoint.

备份 etcd 数据库应作为一个周期性流程来执行，以防节点或存储损坏时丢失关键数据。你可以在控制平面节点上、或通过 API 端点，使用 etcdctl 工具备份、使用 etcdutl 工具恢复 etcd。

Exam Essentials考试要点

Practice backing up etcd练习备份 etcd

Backing up etcd requires the installation of a compatible version of the etcdctl executable. You can identify the version of etcd by inspecting the container image tag used to run the etcd Pod (assuming we are talking about a cluster without high-availability characteristics). The etcd process operates within a container inside the Pod, and examining the Pod’s configuration reveals the command-line flags required to perform the backup operation. In the exam, you can assume that the etcdctl executable has been preinstalled.

备份 etcd 需要安装兼容版本的 etcdctl 可执行文件。你可以通过查看运行 etcd Pod 所用的容器镜像标签来确定 etcd 版本（这里假设我们讨论的是不具备高可用特性的集群）。etcd 进程运行在 Pod 内的一个容器中，检查该 Pod 的配置就能看出执行备份操作所需的命令行 flags。考试时你可以假设 etcdctl 可执行文件已经预装。

— PDF p.77 —

Know how to restore etcd掌握恢复 etcd

Restoring etcd requires the use of the executable etcdutl. You will need to point the command to the snapshot file created in the backup process, and to a target directory used to extract the etcd data into. Just extracting the etcd data into a directory doesn’t tell the etcd process to use it. You need to configure the host path to the directory in the configuration for etcd.

恢复 etcd 需要使用 etcdutl 可执行文件。你需要让命令指向备份过程中创建的快照文件，以及一个用于解出 etcd 数据的目标目录。仅仅把 etcd 数据解到某个目录，并不能告诉 etcd 进程去使用它。你还需要在 etcd 的配置中，把 host path 指向该目录。

Sample Exercises样题练习

Solutions to these exercises are available in Appendix A.

这些练习的参考答案见附录 A。

  1. Navigate to the directory app-a/ch05/etcd-backup-restore of the checked-out GitHub repository bmuschko/cka-study-guide. Start up the VMs running the cluster using the command vagrant up. The cluster consists of a single control plane node named kube-control-plane, and one worker node named kube-worker-1. Open an interactive shell into the control plane node and inspect the currently-used Kubernetes version by listing all the nodes. SSH into the control plane node host machine. Identify the Pod that runs the etcd executable. Inspect the details of the Pod to find out which version of etcd it is running. Write the version to the file etcd-version.txt. Once done, shut down the cluster using vagrant destroy -f. Prerequisite: This exercise requires the installation of the tools Vagrant and a VMware provider.进入已克隆的 GitHub 仓库 bmuschko/cka-study-guide 的目录 app-a/ch05/etcd-backup-restore。用命令 vagrant up 启动运行集群的虚拟机。该集群由一个名为 kube-control-plane 的控制平面节点和一个名为 kube-worker-1 的工作节点组成。打开到控制平面节点的交互式 shell，通过列出所有节点来查看当前使用的 Kubernetes 版本。SSH 登录控制平面节点的宿主机。找出运行 etcd 可执行文件的那个 Pod。查看该 Pod 的详情，弄清它运行的是哪个版本的 etcd。把版本号写入文件 etcd-version.txt。完成后用 vagrant destroy -f 关闭集群。前置条件：本练习需要安装 Vagrant 工具和一个 VMware provider。
  2. Navigate to the directory app-a/ch05/etcd-backup-restore of the checked-out GitHub repository bmuschko/cka-study-guide. Start up the VMs running the cluster using the command vagrant up. The cluster consists of a single control plane node named kube-control-plane, and one worker node named kube-worker-1. Open an interactive shell into the control plane node and inspect the currently-used Kubernetes version by listing all the nodes. The etcdctl and etcdutl tool have been preinstalled on the node kube-control-plane. Back up etcd to the snapshot file /opt/etcd.bak. Restore etcd from the snapshot file. Use the data directory /var/bak. Once done, shut down the cluster using vagrant destroy -f. Prerequisite: This exercise requires the installation of the tools Vagrant and a VMware provider.进入已克隆的 GitHub 仓库 bmuschko/cka-study-guide 的目录 app-a/ch05/etcd-backup-restore。用命令 vagrant up 启动运行集群的虚拟机。该集群由一个名为 kube-control-plane 的控制平面节点和一个名为 kube-worker-1 的工作节点组成。打开到控制平面节点的交互式 shell，通过列出所有节点来查看当前使用的 Kubernetes 版本。节点 kube-control-plane 上已预装 etcdctl 和 etcdutl 工具。把 etcd 备份到快照文件 /opt/etcd.bak。再从该快照文件恢复 etcd，数据目录使用 /var/bak。完成后用 vagrant destroy -f 关闭集群。前置条件：本练习需要安装 Vagrant 工具和一个 VMware provider。
